description: Ijambo ry’Imana ni ryo rituma tugendera mu bugororotsi imbere y’Imana, twejejwe rikadufasha kudacumura.
name: Akamaro k’ Ijambo ry’Imana mu buzima bw’umuntu

description: Hahirwa umuntu uhoraho adaharurako ukugabitanya. Uwo muntu arangwa n’ugushima Imana. Umuntu anyegeza icaha, ntamahoro yogira shiti acihanye. Uwo agira amahoro akitega agakiza k’Imana yiwe.
name: Amahirwe n’umunezero vy’umuntu yahariwe ivyaha vyiwe.

description: Imana irabereye gushimwa ku bintu vyose igenda itugirira. Iryo shimwe rikwiye kuba iryo mu mutima kandi ry’ibihe vyose kugeza no ku ngoma ya Kristo.
name: Amajwi y’ishimwe ku Mana.

description: Izi Zaburi zivuga ivyabaye mu mutima wa Dawidi igihe yariko yitegurira guhunga yelusalemu kuko umuhungu wiwe Abusalomo yari yamugararije.
name: Amasengesho y’Abana b’Imana mu bihe vy’amageragezwa

description: Dawidi amaze gushika mu za bukuru, yasubije amaso inyuma araba ivy’Imana yamukoreye, anezerewe, aca aririmba indirimbo yo guhimbaza Imana kuko Imana yamuhaye kunesha abansi biwe bose. Aheraheza iki kiganiro avuga k’ububasha n’ubushobozi bw’Imana.
name: Amashimwe no guhimbaza Imana kwa Dawidi.

description: Muri zaburi ya 51, Dawidi yisabiye guhingurwa n’Imana kugira arushirize kuyegera no kuyihimbara. Mumazaburi akurikira yariyamirije abansi b’Imana kandi yerekana ko hari ivyizigiro vy’abizera Imana.
name: Dawidi asaba guhingurwa n’Imana.

description: Imana iritwararika cane umuntu naho agenda arwa avyuka, kuko ariwe yahaye kuganza ibikorwa vy’amaboko yayo.Imukiza kenshi iyo agize ivyago. Ivyo nibimutere guhimbaza Imana.
name: Dawidi atangarira igikorwa c’Umuremyi

description: Aha Dawidi yariko atazira Imana kuko yariko yibuka ivyiza yamugiriye n’ibihambaye yamurenganije, hamwe n’amasengesho yamwishuye.
name: Gushima no gutazira Imana inyuma y’igihuhusi.

description: Dawidi yerekanye ingene Imana yumva ugutakamba kw’abantu bayo, kandi yerekana ibikorwa vyayo bitangaje. Yabandanije yerekana ico Imana igomba gushitsa mw’isi. Uhoraho n’umwami w’abami, yama iha abayo ingabire zo gukoresha mu gikorwa cayo.
name: Gushimirimana kubw’inganji yayo y’agahebuza.

description: Imana yacu n’Imana y’inkomezi n’ubushobozi bw’igitangaza, n’inkinzo yacu ihora idukingira ku murango no mw’ijoro. Ituzigama mu bitugora n’ibitubabaza. Uyizigire ntizoguhemukira.
name: Gutahura amabanga y’Imana no gukura mu buryo bw’Impwemu

description: Dukwiye gushima Imana kbw’ibikorwa bihambaye yakoze, kuko ari yo irongora abana bayo ikaba umuremyi n’umucunguzi kandi ko itandukanye n’ibigirwamana
name: Gutazira Imana kubw’ibikorwa yakoze

description: Zaburi (76) n’ubuhanuzi bwerekeye igihe Mesiya azoba ari ku ngoma. Ivuga kuri Yesu Kristo nk’umwami n’umuherezi. Abo mw’isi bose bazomupfukamira. Iya (77) ivuga ku vyo kuzazanirwa kw’abantu mu gihe c’amarushwa kizoza. twigishwa ivy’ Ibihambaye Imana ikora, tukibutswa kw’idashobora guheba abantu bayo.
name: Ibizoba igihe Yesu azoba amaze gutwara ishengero ryiwe

description: Icaha Dawidi yakoze caramubabaje kuko cabaye nk’irabaga ku mpuzu yera derere. Munyuma yaciye aba akarorero k’abami bagenda batunganye. Abandanya yerekana ko Uhoraho ari umutabazi yama adutabara ibihe vyose, kandi ko umwizigira atazotinya namba.
name: Ico Dawidi auga ku vyerekeye umwungere.

description: Uyu mwanditsi yarerekanye ingene itunga ritagira kwubaha Imana ari ubusa. Kandi umunyacubahiro atagira ubwenge ameze nk’igikoko gipfa gusa. Abantu bose barakwiye kwitegurira urubanza rw’Imana. Baheraheza berekana ukwihana kwa Dawidi
name: Iherezo ry’abishimiye ubutunzi, gucira abantu urubanza no gusaba imbabazi.

description: Zaburi (81) Abisirayeli baratakamvye Imana irabatabara, ariko basabwa kuguma bayumvira. Zaburi (82) itubwira ivy’ubwiza bw’Imana,n’ingene izotabara abantu bayo amarushwa azoba mu gihe c’iherezo. Izocira urubanza abahama abantu bayo. Zaburi (83) irimwo amasengesho yo gutakambira Imana ngo ikize abantu bayo ibakure mu minwe y’abansi bayo.
name: Imana iba hafi y’abantu bayo. Guca Imanza zigororotse

description: Zaburi ya 70 ni izaburi yerekana umuntu yitabariza. Zaburi (71) iboneka ko yaririmbwe n’umuntu ageze muza bukuru ngo ibe icibutso. Zaburi (72) ivuga ubuhanuzi bwerekana mesiya aje gushinga ubwami bw’amahoro mw’isi. Zaburi (73) ijanye n’igitabo c’Abalewi nayo ivuga ko ukwezwa n’uguharirwa kujana no gutanga ibimazi.
name: Imana ibana n’abagenda batunganye.

description: Dukwiye kwama twicisha bugufi imbere y’Imana yacu , twerekeza imitima yacu kuri yo tukirindiriye igihe Yesu azogarukira.
name: Imana ikwiriye gutazirwa

description: Dawidi yongeye kuvuga ko umuntu yizigira Uhoraho atazosegenyeshwa. Naho womenga Imana yirengagije ugutakamba kwiwe, iba ifise intumbero kuko iragororotse.
name: Imana ntinezerererwa no guhana.

description: Izi zaburi zifitaniye isano n’igitabo co kuvayo. Kandi izi zaburi za Bene Kora ngo zagenewe kwigisha. Uwu mwanditsi yerekana ingene Abisirayeli bari bafise inyota yo kurondera Imana mu gihe kitoroshe barimwo
name: Imibabaro izoba ku masigarira ishengero ryaravuye mw’isi

description: Aha turabona ukwirata kw’umuntu gushika naho avuga ko adakeneye Imana. Ivyo bituma uwuhambaye ayongobeza umukene
name: Imibabaro y’amasigarira y’abayuda mu misi y’iherezo n’ingene Imana izotabara abayizera mu gihe c’amarushwa kigiye kuza.

description: Dawidi yavugishijwe imibabaro Yesu Kristo yaciyemwo kuva mu buto bwiwe gushika abambwe ku musaraba aducungure. Aravuga kandi n’amasengesho yasenze asaba Se Imana ngo amube hafi, yongera asengera abantu.
name: Imibabaro Yesu yaciyemwo mu buto bwiwe.

description: (101) Aha tubona inganji ya Kristo y’ubugororotsi aho umuntu wese azotunganirizwa. (102) Umwanditsi yerekana isengesho ry’umuntu yugarijwe ariko asuka amajojwa yiwe ku Mana yerekana umubabaro n’agakengegwe afise (103) Aha tuhabona ishimwe ry’ivyiza vyinshi, ubuntu bwinshi Imana itugirira.
name: Indirimbo y’Imana iganje mu bugororotsi ; Isengesho ry’umuntu yugarijwe, Ishimwe ry’ivy’Imana idukorera.

description: (93) Igaragaza ishimwe rizoba ku ngoma ya Mesiya. (94) Isengesho rihamagara Imana ngo isubirize mu nkoko abanyakibi. Amazaburi yose akurikira n’indirimbo z’umunezero n’ishimwe. Aheraheza itumirira abantu kuvugiriza Uhoraho ipmundu kandi bayegere bazi ko turi ibiremwa vyayo.
name: Indirimbo z’umunezero n’ishimwe. Isengesho ryo gusaba guhora,

description: Imana niyo idutabara mu bitugora vyose ni umurinzi n’inkinzo yacu, niyo vyizigiro vy’abizera ibatabara mu bihe vyose
name: Ingenzi ibona urugendo rwayo ruri hafi kurangira

description: Zaburi (78) Aha tuhigira intege nke z’abantu n’ukunanirwa kwabo; tugaca tubona ivy’ubwizigirwa bw’Imana. (79) Ivyago vyabaye ku bisirayeli ntibabitahuye, vyatumye abatari bake bakomantaza imitima yabo. Ariko bazotakambira Imana nayo izobakiza nabo bayihimbaze. (80) Abisirayeri bagize
name: Intege nke z’abantu n’ukunanirwa kwabo n’ubwizigirwa bw’Imana

description: (103) Ikibanza c’umuntu n’ico akwiye kwizera ku vyerekeye kazoza.(104), (107) Aha tuhabona Ishimwe ry’Imana umuremyi. (105), (106) zitwibutsa ivyabaye ku bwoko bwa Isilryeli mu gihe ca Mose.
name: Intumbero umuntu akwiye gukora kugira ngo abane n’Imana.

description: Zaburi (74) yerekana ukuntu Yelusalemu hazoterwa hagatongorwa, hagahumanywa, Ariko kandi basenze basaba gutabarwa. Zaburi (75) yerekana Indirimbo y’intsinzi izoza. Impera n’imperuka Imana izotuma izina ryayo ryubahirizwa mw’Isi. Zaburi (76) aha tubona ingoma ya Yesu nk’umwami n’umuherezi. Abo mw’isi bose bazomupfukamira.
name: Isengesho rya asafu ryo gutabaza Imana

description: Izi zaburi zerekana isengesho rya Dawidi asugerejwe n’abansi biwe, aho yeretse Imana ko at’ahandi yozigamirwa atari muri yo. Yarongeye aravuga no ku kuzuka kwa Mesiya.
name: Isengesho rya Dawidi asugerejwe n’abansi biwe.

description: Aha Dawidi ahera kwerekana ko abantu bashobora kugoreka imanza, ariko Imana yo ica izibereye. Yaciye asaba ko Imana yo mukiza abansi biwe kandi abasabira ivyago. Aca asezerana kwama yizigira Uhoraho.
name: Isengesho rya Dawidi asugerejwe n’abansi.

description: (90 Abisirayeli kubwo kwidodombera Mose benshi bahoneye mu bugaragwa.Mose rero yanditse iyi zaburi asigura urupfu, icaha no gucirwa kw’iteka kugirango agabishe abibona bibazako ata nkomanzi mu vyaha vyabo. (91) Itwereka ahantu heza cane h’igitangaza dushobora kwihisha tukaba mu mahoro ntangere. (92) nayo itwereka ic’ari co urusengero rw’Imana mw’isi, kandi n’igitutu c’ahera h’Imana hazoba ku murwa Yerusalemu.
name: Isengesho rya Mose. Igicapo ca Mesiya Yesu Kristo umwami n’umucunguzi wacu. Intumbero y’umusi w’Imana.

description: Hano Dawidi aremesha abubaha Uhoraho ngo ntibahagarikwe umutima n’abanyakibi baguwe neza. Ivyago ntivyaretse kumushikako ariko yagumye yatura kandi yiteze imbabazi z’Uhoraho, ashishikara ukugororoka.
name: Isezerano ry’umugisha rizoba ku masigarira y’abisirayeli

description: Dukwiye gushima Imana kubw’ibitangaza vyose yakoze kandi ivyo dukora vyose bigira ico bishikako mu gihe bishigikiwe n’Uhoraho.
name: Ishimwe ry’umuntu Uhoraho yakoreye ibikomeye.

description: Naho Abisirayeli baciye mu bihe bigoye, Imana yabaye mu ruhande rwabo ibaha kurangiza urugendo amahoro
name: Ivyabaye ku Bisirayeli mu rugendo rwabo

description: Dawidi amaze gukora icaha c’ubusambanyi, Imana caciye imutumako uwavugishwa n’Imana Natani. Dawidi nawe yaciye aca bugufi arihana kuko yari afise umutima umenetse.
name: Kwihana kwa Dawidi

description: Dawidi yari yaratahuye ko Imana ishobora kureka umuntu agashikirwa n’ingorane, ariko muri vyose yavuze ko azokwama yizigira Uhoraho kandi agatumirira n’abandi kuyizigira.
name: Kwishira mu maboko y’Imana mu bihe vy’amagorwa, kunyoterererwa amazi y’ubugingo hamwe no gutabaza mu bihe vy’ingorane.

description: Muri izi zaburi turabona mwo isengesho ryo kuvuma
name: ryo gutakamba no gusaba imbabazi mu gihe ukwihebura kwabaye umurengera

description: Zaburi (87) Iyerusalemu hazoboneka ubwiza buhambaye mugihe kizoza amahanga menshi akazojayo gusenga Imana. (88)Kwihereza Imana mu kwizera mu bihe vy’umubabaro. (89) aha naho tubona isengesho rya Mose igihe bariko bayerera mu bugararwa
name: Siyoni igisagara c’Imana

description: Muririmbire Uhoraho ishimwe kuko asumba vyose ,arahambaye kandi ateye ubwoba. Ntacoshobora guhagarara imbere yayo, ukuboko kwayo kw’iburyo kwuzuye ukugororoka. Aboroshe n’abahambaye ni babimenye.
name: Ubukuru bwa Yesu Kristo n’inganji yiwe y’agahebuza.

description: Mw’isengesho rya Dawidi yasavye kumenya iherezo ryiwe. Ivyo vyomutera gukora neza mu misi asigaranye, agashira ivyizigiro mu Mana, akanababara abarushwa kuko ubababara afise amasezerano yo kuzigamwa.
name: Ubuzima bufise intumbero iyihe?

description: Umuntu w’Imana wese akwiye kuba maso kuko ashobora gusanga ari kure y’Imana mu gihugu c’inyagano.
name: Ubuzima bw’Abisirayeli mu gihugu c’inyagano

description: Dawudi yavuze ibintu ndwi bikuru bikuru ku vyagezwe vy’Imana: Biratunganye gose, bihembura ubugingo, n’ivyo kwizerwa, Biragororotse, n’ibitanduye, Ukwubaha uhoraho kuratunganye. Amateka y’uhoraho n'ayo ukuri. Uhoraho akwishure ku musi w’amagorwa.
name: Ubwiza bw’ivyaremwe.

description: Dukwiye guhora dushima Imana kuko idata amasezerano, ivyo bizoduhesha umugisha kuko urukundo rwayo ni urw’igitangaza.
name: Ugushima Imana birabereye abakunzi bayo.

description: Dawidi yagize umubabaro mwinshi kubwo guhunga absalomo umuhungu wiwe. Ariko muri vyose yabonye ko iciza ari ugukorera uhoraho umutwaro wiwe. Kandi yaratakambiye uhoraho ngo amube hafi muvyo yariko aracamwo vyose.
name: Ugutakamba kwa Dawidi kubw’ivyo yariko aracamwo.

description: Umuntu arondeye Uhoraho aramubona kandi akamubera inyishu mu vyo aba akeneye vyose. Kimwe gusa dute kure ikibi tumatane n’ivyiza kuko Uhoraho n’umunyembabazi kandi anezerererwa abagenda batunganye.
name: Uhoraho aba hafi yabamwambaza bose.

description: Yesu ni we rufatiro rukomeye rw’ubugingo , ni we buye rigumya imfuruka nayo Ijambo ry’Imana ni ngirakamaro mu buzima bw’umuntu.
name: Uhoraho akwiye gushimwa kuko ari uwo kwizigirwa

description: Imana ibera hose icarimwe, ntaho twoyinyengeza, niyo ishobobora vyose kandi niyo muzigamyi w’abantu bayo.
name: Uhoraho ni Inyabushobozi muri vyose.

description: Ibigirwamana naho bifise ishusho y’ibinyenkomezi ntaco bimarira abavyizigiye ariko abizigiye Uhoraho bo babona ugutabarwa kuva kuri we.
name: Uhoraho ni we Muremyi igirira ikimazi abayizigiye

description: Takambira Imana kuko irumva kando iritwararika umuntu n’aho womengo nta co amaze. Ni yo ikura umuntu mu vyara vy’abamurwanya.
name: Uhoraho yumva ugutakamba kw’abantu biwe

description: Aha Dawidi yar’aruhijwe n’amageragezwa. Yabona umenga Imana yamuhevye. Aca asenga asaba Imana kumukurako umwansi wiwe. Ikindi n’uko isi irimwo ibihumanya vyinshi bigatuma abagororotsi bafatwa nabi. Ariko umugororotsi niwe azoba ku musozi wera w’Imana.
name: Uko Dawidi yifashe mu bihe vy’umubabaro yarimwo.

description: Zaburi ya 45 ivuga kukuboroga kw’abantu b’Imana, abazosigara mu marushwa yagahebuza igihe ishengero ritazoba rikiri mw’isi. Ivuga kandi ivy’ubwiza umwami Yesu azoza afise. Iya 46 N’indirimbo yo gucungurwa itwibutsa iyaririmbwe n’abisirayeli igihe bajabuka ikiyaga gitukura.
name: Ukugaruka kwa kristo aje gushinga ubwami bwiwe

description: Imana ishaka ishimwe riva mu mutima kandi uwuyishikaniye wese iramukiza. Ni Imana izi ibinyegejwe mu mitima yacu vyose tubiyibwire tuyiyegereze , iratwitayeho
name: Ukwihana kw’Abisirayeli n’ishimwe Imana igomba

description: Muri zaburi (84) ivuga cane cane ingene aba bene kora bipfuza kuba mu nyubakwa y’Uhoraho, kuba mu bikorwa vy’Imana biri n’ikimazi kinini cane. Zaburi (85) ivuga ko Imana yiyegereza abantu bayo ikabagirira imbababaza. (86) Iyi zaburi yerekana ko ata gihwanye n’Imana yacu.
name: Umugisha uri mu kuba mu bikorwa vy’Imana

description: Aya majambo ari muri iyi zaburi agereranwa n’amajambo Yesu yavugiye ku musaraba, aho yasaba Imana Data ngo imube hafi. Na Dawidi asugerejwe yisabiye gutabarwa, yongera ashira ho isezerano ryo kubwira bene Data izina ry’uhoraho. Uhoraho niwe mwungere wanje sinzokena.
name: Yesu Kristo n’umwungere mwiza.

description: Isi n’iy’Uhoraho. Uwuzoduga umusozi w’Uhoraho n’uwutunganye mu ngendo ziwe zose, kandi ivyo abikora akiri mw’isi. Ubu rero dusabwa kwugurura imitima yacu ngo umwami w’ubwiza yinjire. Ducururire Imana imitima yacu, tuyaturire ivyaha vyacu , tube incuti yiwe.
name: Yesu Kristo umwungere mukuru mugihe kigiye kuza.
